_comment: Seed content for scripts/seed_database.php. Day counts are offsets back from the moment the seed script runs.

events.title: Anime Cosplay Night 2026
events.description: Dress up as your favourite anime character and walk the runway. Prizes for best costume, best group, and best handmade prop.

events.title: Manga Drawing Workshop
events.description: A hands-on session covering panel layout, inking, and screentones. Materials are provided and no drawing experience is needed.

events.title: Anime Music Video Festival
events.description: A screening night for student-made AMVs, followed by live voting and a short editing talk from last year's winner.

events.title: Japanese Culture Day
events.description: Try calligraphy, origami, and a tea ceremony demonstration, with a Japanese street-food corner running all afternoon.

events.title: Anime Movie Marathon
events.description: An overnight screening of three classic anime films, with free popcorn and a discussion session between each showing.

events.title: Cosplay Photography Session
events.description: Bring your costume and camera to a guided outdoor shoot around the lake. Lighting gear and a photographer mentor are on site.

events.title: Anime Quiz Championship
events.description: Teams of three compete across four rounds of anime trivia, from opening themes to obscure side characters.

events.title: Otaku Game Night
events.description: A casual evening of anime fighting games and rhythm games on the big screen.

events.title: Voice Acting Masterclass
events.description: A guest dubbing artist walks through script reading, breath control, and recording a short scene in the campus booth.

events.title: Studio Ghibli Appreciation Night
events.description: Two Ghibli features back to back, with a short talk on the studio's background art before the first screening.

events.title: Anime Figure Painting Clinic
events.description: Learn to prime, shade, and seal resin figures. Bring your own kit or use one of the practice figures provided.

events.title: J-Pop Dance Cover Battle
events.description: Solo and group dance covers judged on synchronisation, formation, and stage presence. Open to all skill levels.

events.title: Shonen Sports Day
events.description: Relay races, tug of war, and an obstacle course, all themed around classic shonen training arcs.

events.title: Anime Soundtrack Concert
events.description: The campus orchestra performs arrangements of well-known anime scores, with a student choir joining for the finale.

events.title: Manga Book Swap
events.description: Bring manga volumes you have finished and trade them for something new. Unclaimed books go to the campus library.

events.title: Isekai Tabletop RPG Night
events.description: One-shot tabletop campaigns with an isekai premise. Game masters and character sheets are provided for beginners.

events.title: Anime Character Design Talk
events.description: A working illustrator breaks down silhouette, colour scripting, and how character design carries story information.

events.title: Cosplay Prop Building Bootcamp
events.description: A full-day session on foam cutting, heat shaping, and weathering, ending with a finished prop to take home.

events.title: Anime Trivia Speed Round
events.description: A fast lunchtime knockout: ten seconds per question, one wrong answer and you are out.

events.title: Japanese Language Corner
events.description: A relaxed conversation hour for beginners, with volunteers from the Japanese language programme leading small groups.

events.title: Mecha Model Kit Build-Off
events.description: Teams race to assemble and panel-line a grade kit within three hours. Judged on cleanliness and finish.

events.title: Anime Opening Karaoke Night
events.description: An open microphone night for anime openings and endings. Lyrics on screen, no judgement, snacks included.

events.title: Manhwa and Webtoon Reading Club
events.description: A monthly meetup to discuss ongoing webtoons and recommend new series to the group.

events.title: Anime Industry Career Panel
events.description: Panellists from animation, localisation, and event production talk about how they entered the industry from Malaysia.

events.title: New Year Anime Fan Meetup
events.description: An informal start-of-semester meetup for new students to find club members who watch the same series.

posts.author: amir
posts.title: Cosplay Night countdown has started
posts.content: Three weeks left before Cosplay Night and my armour is still half painted. If anyone has spare EVA foam, I will trade snacks for it.

posts.author: junyi
posts.title: What to bring to the manga workshop
posts.content: The studio provides pens and paper, but bring your own eraser and a reference sheet of the character you want to draw. It saves a lot of time.

posts.author: shuhao
posts.title: AMV Festival lineup is looking strong
posts.content: Watched a few of the submitted edits during rehearsal. The sync work this year is on another level, definitely worth getting a seat early.

posts.author: meiling
posts.title: Best anime of the season?
posts.content: Curious what everyone is watching right now. I have been rewatching Spy x Family between classes and it still holds up.

posts.author: priya
posts.title: Photos from the movie marathon
posts.content: Finally sorted through the shots from the overnight screening. Everyone looked exhausted by the third film but nobody left early.

posts.author: arif
posts.title: Old club notice
posts.content: Posted the wrong venue for the quiz night, please ignore this one.

posts.author: aisyah
posts.title: Which Ghibli film should open the night?
posts.content: We can only fit two features into the screening slot. I am leaning towards one quiet film and one adventure, but the vote is still open.

posts.author: kahhoe
posts.title: First attempt at figure painting
posts.content: Thinned the paint too much on the first coat and it pooled everywhere. Stripped it and started again, second attempt is much cleaner.

posts.author: farah
posts.title: Dance cover practice room booking
posts.content: Booked the practice room every Tuesday evening until the battle. Anyone in a group is welcome to share the slot, there is more than enough space.

posts.author: weijie
posts.title: Shonen Sports Day was a disaster in the best way
posts.content: Our relay team dropped the baton twice and still somehow placed third. The obstacle course was harder than it looked in the poster.

posts.author: nadia
posts.title: Heard the orchestra rehearse the concert set
posts.content: Walked past the hall during rehearsal and stayed for twenty minutes. The string arrangement of the finale is worth the ticket on its own.

posts.author: xiaoyu
posts.title: What I am bringing to the book swap
posts.content: Clearing out about fifteen volumes I have already finished. Mostly sports manga and a few one-shots, all in good condition.

posts.author: rajesh
posts.title: Running a table at the tabletop night
posts.content: I will be game mastering one of the beginner tables. No experience needed, the character sheets are already filled in, just show up and pick one.

posts.author: daniel
posts.title: Notes from the character design talk
posts.content: The section on silhouette testing was the most useful part. The idea that a design should read at thumbnail size changed how I sketch.

posts.author: amir
posts.title: Material list for the prop bootcamp
posts.content: Bringing foam, contact cement, and a heat gun. The organisers said blades are provided, so leave your cutters at home.

posts.author: junyi
posts.title: Trivia speed round warm-up questions
posts.content: Posting a few practice questions in the club chat every day this week. Ten seconds each, same format as the real thing.

posts.author: aisyah
posts.title: Beginners are genuinely welcome at language corner
posts.content: A few people asked if they need to know kana first. You do not. Last week half the table was learning greetings from scratch.

posts.author: kahhoe
posts.title: Tool advice for the model kit build-off
posts.content: A cheap nipper will leave stress marks on every cut. If you are buying one tool before the competition, make it a decent single-blade nipper.

posts.author: farah
posts.title: Karaoke night song list is open
posts.content: Add your song to the shared sheet so we can space out the ballads. Currently there are nine people signed up for the same opening.

posts.author: priya
posts.title: What to ask the career panel
posts.content: We can submit questions in advance. I am asking about localisation work specifically, since nobody ever covers that path.

posts.author: nadia
posts.title: Introducing yourself at the fan meetup
posts.content: If you are new this semester, the meetup is the easiest way in. Bring one series you are currently watching and you will find your group.

posts.author: shuhao
posts.title: Camera settings for the cosplay shoot
posts.content: Shooting outdoors near the lake means harsh light around noon. A wide aperture and a reflector will save most of your shots.

posts.author: shurui
posts.title: Looking for a third for the quiz championship
posts.content: Teams are three people and we are two. Strong on shonen, weak on anything before 2000, so ideally someone who has watched the classics.

posts.author: arif
posts.title: Food stalls confirmed for Culture Day
posts.content: Three stalls confirmed so far: takoyaki, taiyaki, and a cold noodle stand. All halal certified, the certificates are with the organisers.

posts.author: meiling
posts.title: Manga workshop recap for anyone who missed it
posts.content: We covered panel flow and basic inking. The instructor shared the practice sheets afterwards, ask in the chat if you want a copy.

posts.author: xiaoyu
posts.title: Software for editing your AMV
posts.content: You do not need an expensive editor. Everything I submitted last year was cut in free software, the timing matters far more than the tools.

posts.author: admin
posts.title: Volunteers needed for the October events
posts.content: We need help with registration desks and crowd flow for Culture Day and the Ghibli screening. Volunteer hours count towards club credit.

posts.author: admin
posts.title: Lost and found after the movie marathon
posts.content: One jacket, a phone charger, and a set of keys were left in Lecture Theatre 3. Collect them from the student services counter.

posts.author: aisyah
posts.title: Cosplay progress thread
posts.content: Starting a thread for costume progress. Post what you are working on, however unfinished it looks, it makes the deadline feel less lonely.

posts.author: daniel
posts.title: Feedback on the event schedule
posts.content: Most events land on weekday evenings, which is difficult for anyone commuting. Could a few of the bigger ones move to weekends?
